$note: Extracted 6 Aug 2026 directly from paginated source PDFs (Rack Rates: 1 page; Contract/Net Rates: 6 pages; both single-property, no adjacent-property risk). Note both PDFs internally header themselves 'Contract 2026' even though the filenames differentiate 'Rack Rates 2026.pdf' vs 'Contract 2026.pdf' — the tables inside make clear one is 'Rack Rates' and the other is 'Net Rates', so used the table headers (not the repeated page header) to distinguish tiers.

validity.note: No explicit start/end validity date stated beyond the 8-column date-window table which runs 1 Jan - 8 Apr 2026 in overlapping/wrapping fashion (see seasons) — appears to be a rolling annual calendar rather than a single stated validity range.

extractionMethod.note: Read directly via pdftotext -layout. Both documents are single, dense tables.

structuralFindings: Rates are per ROOM, Double Occupancy, Bed & Breakfast base — not per person.

Eight rate columns/date-windows rather than a simple 3-4 season model: 01.01-07.01, 08.01-31.03, 01.04-30.07, 01.08-31.08, 01.09-31.10, 01.11-20.12, 20.12-07.01, 03.04-08.04. Note the last two columns overlap oddly with the first/third (20.12-07.01 overlaps the New Year period spanning year boundary; 03.04-08.04 is a short Easter-like sub-window inside the 01.04-30.07 range) — this is exactly as tabulated in the source, not a transcription error; flag as a slightly unusual (possibly Easter-specific) calendar structure worth double-checking with the hotel for exact date-priority rules if a booking falls in an overlapping window.
Eight room categories from Economy Without Balcony through Executive Room With Balcony (3 pax) — full range extracted.

Deluxe Room and Executive Room have explicit extra-occupant supplements (3rd/4th adult and child 2-12) layered on top of the double-occupancy base rate — described in the document's own 'Notes' section, referring to the Deluxe Room as 'Deluxe Junior Suite' inconsistently (same room, two names within the same document).

A parallel, cheaper 'Net Rates' tier exists in the separate Contract 2026.pdf document — this is Sunworld's actual negotiated/confidential net rate, meaningfully lower than Rack (e.g. Economy Without Balcony 01.01-07.01: Rack $180 vs Net $150). Net Rates document also includes a Single Occupancy table (Rack Rates document does NOT have a single-occupancy table at all) and a 'valid offer' row for '3 Nights in Paradise – Pay for 2' with a 3-night minimum stay.
Net Rates are explicitly stated as 'net, confidential, and non-commissionable' in the contract terms — the Agency sets its own sell price on top.
A 2% Tourism Tax is NOT included in either rate and must be paid separately at the property — a distinct exclusion from VAT/service-charge-inclusive properties seen elsewhere in this batch.
Contract validity: 'from the date of signing until December 31, 2026' — auto-terminates at year end unless extended in writing.
